recent.text: My @orlandosports recap as the #Magic see their 4-game win streak end against the Sixers: “Specifically down the stretch, there are things that I can look at and coach better on (and) there are things that we can execute better on,” Sean Sweeney said. https://t.co/9vM631yoHe
recent.author: Jason Beede

recent.text: #Magic forward Franz Wagner's full answer on what the Sixers did defensively against Orlando to hold them to 19 points in the fourth quarter: "They played zone. We didn't execute well against that."
recent.author: Jason Beede

recent.text: Below is the full answer from #Magic guard Jalen Suggs on Orlando’s slow start to the season at home, mentioning the energy in Kia Center: “We’re better in here, the energy will pick up in here. So, we’ve got to do our part first. And I think that second part will come with it.” https://t.co/KzbrizcmMj
recent.author: Jason Beede
recent.quoted_text: #Magic guard Jalen Suggs on Orlando’s 1-5 record at Kia Center to start the season: “We’ve got to be better in here. Point blank, period.”

recent.text: I asked Franz Wagner about the #Magic's 8 missed FTs and if there was a lack of focus vs. Sixers. He replied, "With the free throws? I'm not going to answer that one." I followed up after and he thought I was asking about the free throw discrepancy between the teams (26. vs 17).

recent.text: Jalen Suggs is 3 for 6 from the foul line in the fourth quarter. Each miss has been absolutely brutal. He is the only one other than Franz with any notion to attack this quarter. PHI 116:113 ORL 0:22 4th
recent.author: Orlando Magic Daily

recent.text: Jalen Suggs drains a big catch-and-shoot three with two minutes to play to give the #Magic the lead back. Franz has to keep attacking the paint. He cannot settle. V.J. Edgecombe with a three to beat the shot clock to retake the lead. PHI 114:112 ORL 1:25 4th
recent.author: Orlando Magic Daily

recent.text: Jalen Suggs hits back to back 3s! https://t.co/H1kwITcDIl
recent.author: Orlando Magic

recent.text: The #Magic open the third quarter with a 6-0 run to go back up by double digits. A couple of really nice Franz Wagner drives. The early shooting has created space for him to attack and keeps Embiid from fully committing to him. PHI 64:75 ORL 10:38 3rd
recent.author: Orlando Magic Daily

recent.text: Desmond Bane has hit three 3-pointers tonight vs Philadelphia 76ers It is Bane’s ninth consecutive game with three-or-more 3-pointers made, a franchise record. https://t.co/xNPyXcsyyS
recent.author: Orlando Magic

recent.text: Joel Embiid with two incredible recovery blocks at the rim on Wendell Carter. That is the weakness with Carter. The explosion is not always there -- even though he is playing way more above the rim this year. #Magic are in a bit of danger here. PHI 62:69 ORL 0:07.9 2nd
recent.author: Orlando Magic Daily

recent.text: The #Sixers' size is bothering the #Magic. With no Franz or double-big lineup, they are using Anthony Black and Jamal Cain to defend LeBron James. He is overpowering both. Tacko Fall has been a presence in the paint on both ends. PHI 33:48 ORL 9:00 2nd
recent.author: Orlando Magic Daily

recent.quoted_text: .@OrlandoMagic guard/forward Desmond Bane has hit three 3-pointers tonight vs Philadelphia (4:41, 1st quarter). It is Bane’s ninth consecutive game with three-or-more 3-pointers made, a franchise record. The old record was 8, held by Rashard Lewis from Feb. 24-Mar. 10, 2008.

recent.text: Do you think when Wendell Carter entered the NBA he thought he would ever be a capable primary defender for LeBron? That's what is happening right now. The way AB is attacking and the #Magic are shooting this is looking like last year's Cup game early. PHI 9:24 ORL 5:18 1st

recent.text: Here were #Magic teammates Franz Wagner and Desmond Bane getting up some 3s earlier after shootaround ahead of tonight’s game against Philadelphia: Noah Penda (partially torn right hamstring) was passing the ball to them as we watched them work. https://t.co/1OS355LFBu

recent.text: #Magic coach Sean Sweeney also didn't have a timeline to share when I asked about Izaiyah Nelson, who is 4 months removed from a fractured left ankle. "He's progressing, doing some on-court stuff here, a little bit at a time," Sweeney said. He added the work is "just minimal."
recent.author: Jason Beede
recent.quoted_text: #Magic coach Sean Sweeney said Paolo Banchero (right high ankle sprain) is progressing but “no timeline right now.” Although we didn’t see Banchero on the court during the media-viewing session of shootaround, Sweeney said Banchero is doing well and in good spirits today.
